focus: پیشرفته ۱ · جلسه هفتم · سؤال‌واژه وسط جمله

sentences.fa: مي شه يه لطفي در حقم بکني؟
sentences.en: Could you do me a favor?

sentences.fa: مي شه يه خواهشي ازتون بکنم؟
sentences.en: Can I ask you a favor?

sentences.fa: مي شه لطفاً اين گزارشها رو به چارلز توي واحد حسابداري برسوني؟
sentences.en: Could you please take these reports over to Charles in accounts?

sentences.fa: مي شه يه لطفي بهم بکني؟ خيلي گرفتارم.
sentences.en: Could you do me a favor, I am busy.

sentences.fa: در خدمتتونم، چکار مي تونم براتون کنم؟
sentences.en: I am at your service, what can I do for you?

sentences.fa: پدرم به اين نامه ها نياز داره، مي شه اونا رو برسوني به بدست پدرم توي واحد فروش.
sentences.en: My father needs these letters; could you take them over to my father in the sales department?

sentences.fa: مي تونم ازت يه درخواست کنم؟
sentences.en: Can I ask you a favor?

sentences.fa: چيکار کنم ؟
sentences.en: What shall I do?

sentences.fa: اين روزها خيلي سرم شلوغه، مجبورم تا ديروقت اداره بمونم و اضافه کاري کنم، مي شه اين پرونده ها رو به رييسم توي واحدکارگزيني برسوني؟
sentences.en: I am fully tied up these days; I gotta stay in the office late and work overtime, could you take these files over to my boss in the staff department.

sentences.fa: چيکار کنم برات؟
sentences.en: What shall I do for you?

sentences.fa: از من درخواست شده مأموريت برم، برادرم فردا مي آد اينجا، چکش رو مي خواد و چکش پيش منه، مي شه چک رو فردا بدستش برسوني؟
sentences.en: I have been asked to go on mission; my brother is coming here tomorrow, he wants his check and his check is with me, could you take it over to my brother tomorrow.

sentences.fa: مي شه يه لطفي در حقم انجام بدي؟ دستم بنده، مي شه اين غذا رو بدست پسرم برسوني؟
sentences.en: Could you do me favor? I am up to doing something, Could you take this food over to my son?

sentences.fa: دستم به ظرف شستن بنده.
sentences.en: I am up to washing the dishes.

sentences.fa: دستم به اتو کردن لباسها بنده.
sentences.en: I am up to ironing the clothes.

sentences.fa: دستم به تايپ کردن نامه ها بنده.
sentences.en: I am up to typing the letters.

sentences.fa: بامن تماس گرفته شده و مجبورم برگردم اداره.
sentences.en: I have been called and I gotta get back to the office.

sentences.fa: مي شه اين جعبه ها بدست همکارم برسوني؟
sentences.en: Could you take these boxes over to my colleague?

sentences.fa: کار مهمي برام پيش اومده، مجبورم برم بيرون.
sentences.en: Something important has come up to me, I gotta go out.

sentences.fa: کار مهمي برام پيش اومده.
sentences.en: Something important has come up for me.

sentences.fa: ديشب مهموني بهت خوش گذشت؟
sentences.en: Did you have a good time at the party last night?

sentences.fa: جات خالي بود ولي ديشب توي پارتي نموندم.
sentences.en: I thought of you but I didn't stay at the party last night.

sentences.fa: کار مهمي برام پيش اومد، مجبور شدم اداره رو ترک کنم.
sentences.en: Something important came up to me; I had to leave the office.

sentences.fa: کار مهمي برام پيش اومده، مي شه اين پيچ گوشتي رو بدست پدرم توي انبار برسوني؟
sentences.en: Something important has come up to me, could you take this screw driver over to my father in the stock room.

sentences.fa: دستم بنده.
sentences.en: I am up to doing something.

sentences.fa: نمي دونم.
sentences.en: I don't know.

sentences.fa: اون کيه؟
sentences.en: Who is she?

sentences.fa: نمي دونم اون کيه؟
sentences.en: I don't know who she is?

sentences.fa: مادرت کي رو دوست داره؟
sentences.en: Who does your mother like?

sentences.fa: مي دونم مادرت کي رو دوست داره؟
sentences.en: I know who your mother likes?

sentences.fa: چه مدل غذايي رو دوست داري؟
sentences.en: What kind of food do you like?

sentences.fa: نمي دونم چه مدل غذايي رو دوست داري؟
sentences.en: I don't know what kind of food you like?

sentences.fa: مادر شبها کجا مي ره؟
sentences.en: Where does your mother go at nights?

sentences.fa: به من چه مربوطه مادرت شبها کجا مي ره.
sentences.en: It's none of my business where your mother goes at nights.

sentences.fa: چيکار مي کني؟
sentences.en: What are you doing?

sentences.fa: مي دونم چيکار مي کني؟
sentences.en: I know what you are doing?

sentences.fa: مادرت در مورد چي صحبت مي کنه؟
sentences.en: What is your mother talking about?

sentences.fa: بمن چه مربوطه که مادرت در مورد چي داره صحبت مي کنه؟
sentences.en: It's none of my business what your mother is talking about?

sentences.fa: مي خوايي بعد از تطيلات چيکار کني؟
sentences.en: What are you gonna do after holiday?

sentences.fa: مي دونم بعد از تعطيلات مي خواهي چيکار کني؟
sentences.en: I know what you are gonna do after the holiday?

sentences.fa: برادرت کي رو مي خواد دعوت کنه؟
sentences.en: Who is your brother gonna invite here?

sentences.fa: مي دوني برادرت مي خواد کي رو دعوت کنه؟
sentences.en: Do you know who your brother is gonna invite?

sentences.fa: مادرت چي گفت؟
sentences.en: What did your mother say?

sentences.fa: مي دوني مادرت چي گفت؟
sentences.en: Do you know what your mother said?

sentences.fa: چي براي شوهرت پارسال خريدي؟
sentences.en: What did you buy for your husband last year?

sentences.fa: يادم نمي آد پارسال چي براي شوهرم خريدم؟
sentences.en: I don't remember what I bought for my husband last year?

sentences.fa: چرا برادرت شام بيرون خورد؟
sentences.en: Why did you brother eat dinner out?

sentences.fa: مي دونم چرا برادرت بيرون غذا خورد؟
sentences.en: I know why your brother ate out?

sentences.fa: چرا مادرت در رو قفل کرده؟
sentences.en: Why has your mother locked the door?

sentences.fa: مي شه بهم بگي چرا مادرت در رو قفل کرده؟
sentences.en: Could you tell me why your mother has locked the door?

sentences.fa: چي براي برادرت خريدي؟
sentences.en: What have you bought for your brother?

sentences.fa: مي دونم چي براي برادرت خريدي؟
sentences.en: I know what you have bought for your brother?

sentences.fa: چي سفارش دادي؟
sentences.en: What have you ordered?

sentences.fa: مي شه بهم بگي چي سفارش دادي؟
sentences.en: Could you tell me what you have ordered?

sentences.fa: بمن چه مربوطه براي چي مي خواي اخراجم کني؟
sentences.en: It's none of my business why you are gonna fire me.

sentences.fa: مي فهمي داري در مورد چي صحبت مي کني؟
sentences.en: Do you understand what you are talking about?

sentences.fa: بمن چه مربوطه چرا مادرت هر روز دير بيدار مي شه؟
sentences.en: It's none of my business why your mother wakes up late every day.

sentences.fa: مي دوني چيکار کردم؟
sentences.en: Do you know what you have done?

sentences.fa: نمي دونم چرا اينجا پارک کرد؟
sentences.en: I don't know why he parked here.

sentences.fa: مي دونم چرا داري گريه مي کني؟
sentences.en: I know why you are crying?

sentences.fa: برادرت شبيه کيه؟
sentences.en: What does your brother look like?

sentences.fa: مادرت شبيه کيه؟
sentences.en: What does your mother look like?

sentences.fa: دوستت شبيه کيه؟
sentences.en: What does your friend look like?

sentences.fa: شبيه کي هستي؟
sentences.en: What do you look like?

sentences.fa: شبيه برادرم هستم.
sentences.en: I look like my brother.

sentences.fa: برادرم شبيهمه.
sentences.en: My brother looks like me.

sentences.fa: خواهرت شبيهته؟
sentences.en: Does your sister look like you?

sentences.fa: شبيه پدرمه.
sentences.en: She looks like my father.

sentences.fa: پدرت چه شکليه؟
sentences.en: What does your father look like?

sentences.fa: مي دوني پدرت چه شکليه؟
sentences.en: I know what your father looks like.

sentences.fa: مي دوني برادرت چه شکليه؟
sentences.en: Do you know what your brother looks like?

sentences.fa: يادم نمي آد خواهرت چه شکليه؟ تا حالا نديدمش.
sentences.en: I don't remember what your sister look like. I have never seen her.

sentences.fa: در خدمتتونم چه فرمايشي داريد؟
sentences.en: I am at your service, what can I do for you?

sentences.fa: ولي نمي تونم بيادم بيارم چه شکلي هست.
sentences.en: But I can't remember what he looks like.

sentences.fa: مي شه بهم بگي چه شکلي هست.
sentences.en: Could you tell me what he looks like?

sentences.fa: مي ترسم، يادم نياد چه شکلي بود.
sentences.en: I am afraid I don't remember what he looks like.

sentences.fa: تابلو هست.
sentences.en: You can't miss him.

sentences.fa: از قطار جا موندم.
sentences.en: I have missed the train.

sentences.fa: ديشب از قطار جا موندم.
sentences.en: I missed the train last night.

sentences.fa: مي شه بهم بگي دفتر پست کجاست؟
sentences.en: Could you tell me where the post office is?

sentences.fa: نمي توني گمش کني.
sentences.en: You can't miss there.

sentences.fa: مي شه رکوردر رو به دست پسرم برسوني؟
sentences.en: Could you take this recorder over to my son?

sentences.fa: پسرت رو نديدم، نمي دونم شبيه کي هست.
sentences.en: I haven't seen you son; I don't know what he looks like.

sentences.en: He looks like my brother.

sentences.fa: برادرم به من رفته.
sentences.en: My brother takes after me.

sentences.fa: تو به برادرت رفتي؟
sentences.en: Do you take after your brother?

sentences.fa: به کي رفتي؟
sentences.en: Who do you take after?

sentences.fa: پسرت به کي رفته؟
sentences.en: Who does your son take after?

sentences.fa: نمي دونم برادرت به کي رفته.
sentences.en: I don't know who your brother takes after.

sentences.fa: من به پدرم رفتم.
sentences.en: I take after my father.

sentences.fa: من شبيه برادرمم.
sentences.en: I look like my brother.

sentences.fa: من به برادرم رفتم.
sentences.en: I take after my brother.

sentences.fa: برادرم کپ منه.
sentences.en: My brother is a clone of me.

sentences.fa: تو کپ برادرتي.

words.fa: بردن چيزي و به دست کسي رساندن

words.en: I am up to doing something
My brother is a clone of me

conversation: A: Could you please take these reports over to Charles in account?
B: Certainly, but i am afraid I don't remember what he looks like?
A: You can't miss him. He is about your height, rather heavy with dark curly hair.
B: Ok, I think, I recognize him.
A: Thanks very much, it's kind of you.
